title: tumbulleh amixxige wayta zambih warse
intro: Qur'aanak inki inki aydaaditte inkih tan ummatta edde raddam duddah tan umaadoobah addatino baxxaqissa. Tama farmoyti dubuk sooleh, keenik afal uli agat kattaate wayteh tan umaaneh addat culte ummattah xaaqimeh. Sanootah maabitina takke way, sorkocô baxitte maqarrowteh sugteeh, qibaadah amri kaxxam bohoy le gurral gufe. tama farmoyta yallih farmoyta baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu keenik afal uli agattinaane abe wayteh tan umaanet raddeh tan ummattah maabitina akkuk ruube.
Yi ummatta dirabboytah yoo secteeh, yoo kee yi kataysis baaxok diiriyoonuh yoo meysiisen.
Massakaxxa le gufneh yemeete mari yi buxah yemeete qunxaaneyti uluuluka weelol, kee anu ken amaanah kaxxa rooka yot tammulleeh tan.
Yi ummatta anu inni qibina keenih taceem esserte, too gufne Yalli ruube malaykoota kinnim aaxaguk masuginna.
Yi barra yi imaanat matabtaay, bayte mara luk darrel raqtam doorite.
Anu inni saybaxa lih maaci uddur, finqitte rob radeeh, ni magaalol finqitteh.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Mu'minin mara kattaata wak kak rade
Buxâ mari kaxxa weeqi addat rabe
Buxâ mari cattiimeh aamanti sinni barrak iroh
outcome.answer: Buxâ mari cattiimeh aamanti sinni barrak iroh

arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims. (51:36)
